hangulquest.culture.chuseok.summary: At Chuseok the full moon rises. They eat songpyeon (rice cakes).
hangulquest.culture.chuseok.text: Chuseok is the Korean harvest festival, on the 15th day of the 8th lunar month, when the autumn moon is full. Families travel to their hometowns, honor their ancestors, and share songpyeon, half-moon-shaped rice cakes filled with sesame, chestnuts or sweet beans. Like Seollal, it is a three-day holiday around the date.
hangulquest.culture.chuseok.title: Chuseok: the harvest festival
hangulquest.culture.hanbok.summary: Hanbok has beautiful colors. The colors come from flowers and plants.
hangulquest.culture.hanbok.text: Hanbok is traditional Korean clothing with a short jacket, the jeogori, and a wide skirt or trousers. Its colors used to come from plants: safflower for red, indigo for blue and gardenia for yellow. In the game, flowers give dyes in much the same way.
hangulquest.culture.hanbok.title: Hanbok: traditional clothes
hangulquest.culture.hanok.summary: A hanok is built from wood and roof tiles. The ends of the roof curve up to the sky.
hangulquest.culture.hanok.text: A hanok is a traditional Korean house with a wooden frame, clay walls and a roof of curved clay tiles called giwa. The wide eaves give shade in summer and let the low winter sun reach the room. In the game, deepslate tiles make a good gray giwa roof.
hangulquest.culture.hanok.title: Hanok: the traditional house
hangulquest.culture.jangdok.summary: Inside the jangdok there are soybean paste and soy sauce.
hangulquest.culture.jangdok.text: A jangdok is a large earthenware jar in which soy sauce, soybean paste (doenjang) and chili paste (gochujang) ferment and are kept. The clay lets air through, and the jars stand in the sun on a raised platform in the yard called jangdokdae. The barrel is the closest storage block in the game.
hangulquest.culture.jangdok.title: Jangdok: jars for sauces
hangulquest.culture.kimchi.summary: Kimchi is made from napa cabbage. You add salt and chili powder.
hangulquest.culture.kimchi.text: Kimchi is a Korean side dish of salted vegetables, usually napa cabbage, mixed with chili powder, garlic and ginger and left to ferment. Families traditionally make enough for the winter together in late autumn; this custom, called kimjang, was added to UNESCO's list of intangible cultural heritage in 2013. The game has no kimchi, but the fermented spider eye is a fermented ingredient, too.
hangulquest.culture.kimchi.title: Kimchi
hangulquest.culture.ondol.summary: In an ondol room the floor is warm. The heat of the fire goes under the floor.
hangulquest.culture.ondol.text: Ondol is the traditional Korean floor heating. A wood fire burns in a stove opening next to the room, and the hot air and smoke flow through channels under a stone floor covered with clay and paper before they leave through a chimney. In the game, the furnace is the closest thing to that fire.
hangulquest.culture.ondol.title: Ondol: heated floors
hangulquest.culture.seollal.summary: At Seollal the family gathers. They eat tteokguk (rice cake soup).
hangulquest.culture.seollal.text: Seollal is the Korean Lunar New Year, on the first day of the first lunar month, in late January or February. Families gather, the young bow deeply to their elders (sebae), and everybody eats tteokguk, rice cake soup, to begin the new year. The date moves every year because it follows the lunar calendar.
hangulquest.culture.seollal.title: Seollal: Lunar New Year
hangulquest.culture.yutnori.summary: In yutnori you throw four yut sticks. Do, gae, geol, yut or mo comes up.
hangulquest.culture.yutnori.text: Yutnori is a traditional board game, often played at Seollal. You throw four wooden sticks and count how many land flat side up: one is do, two is gae, three is geol, four is yut and none is mo. The five names are said to mean pig, dog, sheep, cow and horse; in the game, two planks make exactly four sticks.
hangulquest.culture.yutnori.title: Yutnori: the game with sticks

hangulquest.story.animals_bees.p1: This morning there was a bee nest in the forest. There were flowers next to the nest, and there were bees, too.
hangulquest.story.animals_bees.p2: When there is lots of honey in a bee nest, you can collect honey with a glass bottle.
hangulquest.story.animals_bees.p3: I took a glass bottle and went to the bee nest. Then I collected honey.
hangulquest.story.animals_bees.p4: There was honey in the glass bottle. I drank the honey. The honey was really tasty!
hangulquest.story.animals_bees.title: Bees and honey
hangulquest.story.animals_farm.p1: There is a fence next to our house. There are many animals inside the fence.
hangulquest.story.animals_farm.p2: There is one cow, three chickens and two sheep.
hangulquest.story.animals_farm.p3: In the morning the chickens lay eggs. I collect the eggs.
hangulquest.story.animals_farm.p4: There is one pig, too. The pig eats carrots.
hangulquest.story.animals_farm.p5: There is a cat, too. The cat sleeps inside the house.
hangulquest.story.animals_farm.p6: I am here with the animals. I am really happy!
hangulquest.story.animals_farm.title: The animals at our house
hangulquest.story.animals_wolf.p1: Yesterday I went to the forest. There was a wolf in the forest. I held a bone.
hangulquest.story.animals_wolf.p2: I gave the bone to the wolf. If I keep giving it bones, the wolf becomes my friend.
hangulquest.story.animals_wolf.p3: Now the wolf is my friend. When I go, the wolf goes along. We walk together.
hangulquest.story.animals_wolf.p4: When a zombie comes at night, the wolf fights. So I am not scared at night, either.
hangulquest.story.animals_wolf.p5: I came home and lay down on my bed. The wolf sat in front of the house.
hangulquest.story.animals_wolf.title: My wolf
hangulquest.story.cave_coal.p1: I go into the cave. It is dark inside the cave. I have no torch.
hangulquest.story.cave_coal.p2: There is coal next to the stone. I take a pickaxe and mine the coal.
hangulquest.story.cave_coal.p3: I collect three pieces of coal. Then I go home.
hangulquest.story.cave_coal.p4: At home I make torches from sticks and coal.
hangulquest.story.cave_coal.p5: I place a torch inside the cave. Now the cave is bright. That is really good!
hangulquest.story.cave_coal.title: The first coal
hangulquest.story.cave_deep.p1: Yesterday I went down into a cave. The cave was very deep.
hangulquest.story.cave_deep.p2: Before going down I made lots of torches. It was dark inside the cave.
hangulquest.story.cave_deep.p3: I found diamonds at the bottom of the cave. You can mine diamonds with an iron pickaxe.
hangulquest.story.cave_deep.p4: I mined two diamonds. Before climbing up I saw a bat. Bats live in caves.
hangulquest.story.cave_deep.p5: I went home. I put the diamonds into a chest. I was really happy!
hangulquest.story.cave_deep.title: Down into the cave
hangulquest.story.colors_dye.p1: Today I made dye. I will use it on a sheep.
hangulquest.story.colors_dye.p2: First I made blue dye from lapis lazuli.
hangulquest.story.colors_dye.p3: I used the blue dye on a sheep. The sheep's wool was blue.
hangulquest.story.colors_dye.p4: I sheared the wool with shears.
hangulquest.story.colors_dye.p5: If a sheep eats grass, its wool grows again.
hangulquest.story.colors_dye.p6: Now I have lots of wool. I will make a bed.
hangulquest.story.colors_dye.title: Blue wool
hangulquest.story.end_dragon.p1: I went to the End. There were many endermen in the End. You must not look at an enderman.
hangulquest.story.end_dragon.p2: I had to shoot the end crystals with a bow and arrows. The more crystals there are, the harder it is to defeat the Ender Dragon.
hangulquest.story.end_dragon.p3: I shot the crystals and defeated the dragon.
hangulquest.story.end_dragon.p4: When you defeat the Ender Dragon, a dragon egg appears. I saw the dragon egg.
hangulquest.story.end_dragon.p5: Then I found elytra on a ship in the End. If you wear elytra, you can fly through the sky.
hangulquest.story.end_dragon.p6: The higher you climb, the farther away the ground gets. The sky of the End was really amazing!
hangulquest.story.end_dragon.title: The sky of the End
hangulquest.story.festival_night.p1: Last night there was a festival in the village. I made a cake.
hangulquest.story.festival_night.p2: A cake is made from milk, sugar, eggs and wheat.
hangulquest.story.festival_night.p3: I rang the bell. When you ring a bell, it makes a sound.
hangulquest.story.festival_night.p4: I placed a jukebox on the road with the lanterns. Music comes out of the jukebox.
hangulquest.story.festival_night.p5: While I listened to the music, I ate a big cake.
hangulquest.story.festival_night.p6: The cake was tasty, so I ate one more slice. The festival was really fun!
hangulquest.story.festival_night.title: The village festival
hangulquest.story.field_flowers.p1: This morning there were lots of yellow flowers next to the field.
hangulquest.story.field_flowers.p2: There were dandelions and sunflowers. A sunflower is a big yellow flower, like the sun.
hangulquest.story.field_flowers.p3: I collected dandelions. Then I made yellow dye from the dandelions. You can make yellow dye from sunflowers.
hangulquest.story.field_flowers.p4: I have lots of yellow dye, but I have no wool. Tomorrow I will go to the sheep.
hangulquest.story.field_flowers.title: Yellow flowers
hangulquest.story.field_harvest.p1: I am in the field. Today I plant wheat seeds.
hangulquest.story.field_harvest.p2: First I take the hoe and turn the soil into a field. Then I plant the seeds.
hangulquest.story.field_harvest.p3: It rains at night. In the morning the wheat grows.
hangulquest.story.field_harvest.p4: The wheat is yellow. Now I harvest the wheat.
hangulquest.story.field_harvest.p5: I make bread from the wheat. The bread is really tasty!
hangulquest.story.field_harvest.p6: I give wheat to the cow, too. And I get milk from the cow. I am happy.
hangulquest.story.field_harvest.title: The small field
hangulquest.story.field_water.p1: Today I made a field. First I took a hoe and turned the soil into a field.
hangulquest.story.field_water.p2: There was no water next to the field. If there is no water, wheat does not grow well.
hangulquest.story.field_water.p3: So I placed water next to the field with a bucket. Then I planted wheat seeds.
hangulquest.story.field_water.p4: I also made a fence next to the field. If there is a fence, animals do not go into the field.
hangulquest.story.field_water.p5: Now I wait. When the wheat grows, I will harvest it. Then I will make bread.
hangulquest.story.field_water.title: Water next to the field
hangulquest.story.fire_campfire.p1: It was evening. The sun set. Night came. The sky was dark.
hangulquest.story.fire_campfire.p2: I made a campfire from logs, sticks and coal. Then I placed the campfire.
hangulquest.story.fire_campfire.p3: I placed pork on the campfire. While I was cooking the meat, I sat down next to the campfire.
hangulquest.story.fire_campfire.p4: The firelight was warm. There were many stars in the sky. The moon was there, too.
hangulquest.story.fire_campfire.p5: I ate the cooked pork. It was tasty. The night is long, but it is okay.
hangulquest.story.fire_campfire.title: A campfire at night
hangulquest.story.fire_night.p1: The sun sets. Night comes. It is dark outside.
hangulquest.story.fire_night.p2: I am in front of the house. There is a moon in the sky. There are stars, too.
hangulquest.story.fire_night.p3: I am scared! But I have a torch.
hangulquest.story.fire_night.p4: I place the torch. The fire is bright. Now I am not scared.
hangulquest.story.fire_night.p5: I sit down next to the torch. The firelight is warm. The moon is pretty, too.
hangulquest.story.fire_night.p6: The night is long. But it is okay. I have a torch.
hangulquest.story.fire_night.title: The first night
hangulquest.story.fire_torches.p1: Today I went into a cave. It was very dark inside the cave.
hangulquest.story.fire_torches.p2: When it is dark, zombies come. So I placed a torch. Next to the torch it was bright.
hangulquest.story.fire_torches.p3: The more torches there are, the brighter the cave is. So I placed lots of torches.
hangulquest.story.fire_torches.p4: I mined lots of stone and coal. When I left, I was not scared, because I had torches.
hangulquest.story.fire_torches.p5: Outside the cave it was still day.
hangulquest.story.fire_torches.title: Torches in the cave
hangulquest.story.house_first.p1: It is morning. I am outside. Today I build a house.
hangulquest.story.house_first.p2: First I chop down trees. There are lots of logs. I make planks.
hangulquest.story.house_first.p3: There is stone next to the tree. And I mine the stone.
hangulquest.story.house_first.p4: Now I build the house. I put a door in the house. I put in glass, too.
hangulquest.story.house_first.p5: Inside the house I place a bed. I place a chest, too. Last, I place a torch.
hangulquest.story.house_first.p6: The house is warm. I lie down on the bed. Now I sleep. It is really good!
hangulquest.story.house_first.title: My first house
hangulquest.story.house_window.p1: This morning I was at home. In the house there were a door, a bed and a torch. But there was no glass pane.
hangulquest.story.house_window.p2: So I went to the beach. There was lots of sand on the beach. I collected a lot of sand.
hangulquest.story.house_window.p3: I came home. I put coal and sand into the furnace. I waited a little. Then I took glass out of the furnace.
hangulquest.story.house_window.p4: I made a glass pane from the glass. Before I placed the glass pane, the house was a little dark. I placed the glass pane in the house.
hangulquest.story.house_window.p5: I placed a flower pot next to the bed, too. I planted a flower in the pot.
hangulquest.story.house_window.p6: Now the glass pane is a window. The house is bright. I lie down on the bed. It is really nice!
hangulquest.story.house_window.title: The first window in my house
hangulquest.story.journey_map.p1: I had to go to the jungle. The road was long.
hangulquest.story.journey_map.p2: So first I made a compass. A compass is made from four iron ingots and one redstone dust.
hangulquest.story.journey_map.p3: Then I made a map from eight sheets of paper and the compass.
hangulquest.story.journey_map.p4: When the sun sets, it becomes night. So I walked with a torch in my hand.
hangulquest.story.journey_map.p5: I arrived in the jungle and went to see the parrots. Parrots live in the jungle.
hangulquest.story.journey_map.p6: If you look at the map, you can find the way. I looked at the map and went home.
hangulquest.story.journey_map.title: The road to the jungle
hangulquest.story.market_trade.p1: Today I harvested lots of wheat. I took the wheat and went to the market.
hangulquest.story.market_trade.p2: There were many villagers at the market. The villager next to the composter buys wheat.
hangulquest.story.market_trade.p3: I gave the villager wheat. The villager gave me emeralds.
hangulquest.story.market_trade.p4: I bought bread with the emeralds. If you have emeralds, you can buy bread at the market.
hangulquest.story.market_trade.p5: I ate the bread. It was tasty. Tomorrow I will go to the market again.
hangulquest.story.market_trade.title: At the market
hangulquest.story.meals_cake.p1: Today a friend came to my house. I made a cake.
hangulquest.story.meals_cake.p2: Before making the cake, I collected wheat, sugar, eggs and milk.
hangulquest.story.meals_cake.p3: I got milk from a cow with a bucket. A chicken laid an egg. I collected the egg, too.
hangulquest.story.meals_cake.p4: I made the cake at the crafting table. Then I placed the cake.
hangulquest.story.meals_cake.p5: You can eat the cake several times. I ate it together with my friend. It was really tasty!
hangulquest.story.meals_cake.title: Cake with a friend
hangulquest.story.nether_fortress.p1: I went to the Nether. The Nether is very hot.
hangulquest.story.nether_fortress.p2: There are blazes in the Nether. If you defeat a blaze, you can get a blaze rod.
hangulquest.story.nether_fortress.p3: I had to defeat a blaze. So I took a bow and arrows with me.
hangulquest.story.nether_fortress.p4: I made a brewing stand from one blaze rod and three cobblestones.
hangulquest.story.nether_fortress.p5: I filled a glass bottle with water. Then I put the bottle and Nether wart into the brewing stand and made a potion.
hangulquest.story.nether_fortress.p6: I will go home and drink the potion.
hangulquest.story.nether_fortress.title: Blazes and potions
hangulquest.story.nether_piglin.p1: In the Nether I met a piglin. Piglins like gold.
hangulquest.story.nether_piglin.p2: I gave a gold ingot to the piglin. Then the piglin gives you an item.
hangulquest.story.nether_piglin.p3: The items a piglin gives are different every time. While I waited, I watched the piglin.
hangulquest.story.nether_piglin.p4: You must not open a chest near a piglin. Piglins attack, so you have to be careful.
hangulquest.story.nether_piglin.p5: I did not open the chest. I got an item and was happy. The Nether is hot, but gold is great.
hangulquest.story.nether_piglin.title: Piglins and gold
hangulquest.story.sea_boat.p1: Today I went out to sea in a boat. The sea was wide and deep.
hangulquest.story.sea_boat.p2: I arrived on an island and walked along the beach. There was a turtle on the beach.
hangulquest.story.sea_boat.p3: Turtles swim in the water. And they lay eggs on the beach.
hangulquest.story.sea_boat.p4: I went to catch fish with a fishing rod. When I catch a fish, I grill it right away and eat it.
hangulquest.story.sea_boat.p5: Before the sun set, I came home by boat. The trip to sea was really good!
hangulquest.story.sea_boat.title: A day at sea
hangulquest.story.weather_rain.p1: It is raining today. The sky is dark.
hangulquest.story.weather_rain.p2: I take a fishing rod and go to the river. I sit down next to the river.
hangulquest.story.weather_rain.p3: I catch two fish. One is small and one is big.
hangulquest.story.weather_rain.p4: I go home. At home I grill the fish. The fish tastes really good!
hangulquest.story.weather_rain.p5: It is raining outside. But inside the house I am happy. The fire is warm.
hangulquest.story.weather_rain.title: A rainy day
hangulquest.story.weather_snow.p1: Last night it snowed a lot. In the morning there was snow on the ground.
hangulquest.story.weather_snow.p2: I held a snowball. Before I threw it, I saw a fox.
hangulquest.story.weather_snow.p3: The fox was in the snow. I did not throw the snowball. The fox went up into the mountains.
hangulquest.story.weather_snow.p4: It was cold outside. I sat down next to the campfire. The campfire was warm.
hangulquest.story.weather_snow.p5: I placed a snow block next to the house. The snow block was cold. I went into the house. Inside the house it was really warm.
hangulquest.story.weather_snow.title: A snowy morning

hangulquest.ui.research.consent:
Hangul Quest research export

You made this zip yourself, on your computer, with the button "Export research data" in the journal settings. Nothing was sent anywhere. Whether you share it is entirely up to you; if you do not want to, just delete it.

What is in it
- reviews.ndjson: one line per answer or encounter with a word: the time, a hashed word id, how it was answered (mode and grade), how long it took, how many days passed since the previous review, a short place label (quiz, quest, card or probe), the experiment arm of the word, and whether it is a core word.
- The word ids are hashed with a random key that was made for this export and then thrown away. The same word has a different hash in every export, so the ids cannot be turned back into words and two exports cannot be linked.

What is not in it
No player, account, world, server or chat names, no coordinates, no IP address, no settings, no quest or trail names. The times are real: they show when you played.

Why share it
The Hangul Quest project compares review settings word by word to learn what helps people remember Korean. Sharing is voluntary and manual: attach the file yourself, where the project page says to.
